phrases.text: Treasure Hunters ends December 5. That's 24 days left to find Pirate Shop Access!
Every chest you open is a ticket: one in one hundred thirty seven thousand five hundred.
Find it, and the Item Shop is free for 14 days. You keep everything.
And Treasure Hours boost the odds every Saturday.
How many chests will you open before it's gone?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
